commands.name: diagnose-instrumented-repro
commands.command: focused repro (Mac smoke server on 24811, client in the container, Xvfb :94): copy small, edge, check; move away; copy 600 KB, edge; poll `xclip -o | wc -c` every ~0.7 s for 28 s. Temporary stderr lines in the client protocol session (DCLP complete), ClientCoordinator.applyInbound (admit refused) and ClientClipboardWriter (write start/done).
commands.stdout:
small: <synthetic small text, matched>
t=0.51 bytes=11 match=no
... 38 more polls ...
t=28.2 bytes=11 match=no
client stderr:
ZZDBG dclp complete 23
ZZDBG write start 11
ZZDBG write done success()
ZZDBG dclp complete 600027
ZZDBG admit refused clipboard(KVMContracts.ClipboardErrorCode.loopRejected)
commands.note: Root cause: the 600 KB transfer is fully reassembled by the protocol session, but ClientCoordinator's ClipboardLoopGuard rejects it as loopRejected, so it never reaches the clipboard writer; the display keeps the previous 11-byte text indefinitely (not a timing issue). BarrierClientProtocolSession emits inbound payloads with contentHash "", and the guard's rule 4 (equal hash) rejects every server clipboard after the first in a session. In the E2E the session first receives the reconnect clipboard, so the 600 KB one is the second.
